hook: Early detection changes everything about oral cancer
caption:
84% survival rate. That number is real, and it belongs to people whose oral cancer got found early.

The problem is that most cases aren't caught early. Symptoms get dismissed, screenings get skipped, and by the time something looks serious, the window for the best outcomes has already narrowed.

It doesn't have to go that way. A free, two-minute risk screener can help you understand where you stand right now.

Check your risk at oralcheck.org.
